name: Search and papers as the way in
description: Brings outside material in for a query through the selected search arm and, for research questions, the selected paper lookup.
advantages: One call returns an answer with the sources a reader can check.
disadvantages: Tool and MCP servers are not a way in here, only search and papers.

name: Hand-wired general agent framework
description: A team picks a general agent framework (for example LangChain, LlamaIndex or the OpenAI Agents SDK) and writes its own glue for models, search, memory and tools, with each part chosen by taste and tried together by hand.
advantages: Large community, many ready connectors and full control over how the parts are wired.
disadvantages: Every team repeats the wiring and the choices, defaults are not measured and nobody tests the assembled whole against shared cases.

name: The parts of the world
description: The record that names the second-level solutions of World: Science and Tools, with Web Search inside Tools. It carries no code of its own; the arm that runs today, search_backends, takes in a web search and papers.
advantages: The second-level solutions are listed in one place and each keeps its own implementations.
disadvantages: A specification only: it adds no implementation of its own.

name: Answers through the Assembler and reaches the other containers
description: Hands the request to the Assembler, which builds every part from its selected arm, and reaches the outside through World. The seats of Body, Intelligence and Consciousness are built on first use, so a request never asks for what only they would need.
advantages: One call answers for the whole; each container can improve without changing the call.
disadvantages: It adds a level between the caller and the Assembler, and Body, Intelligence and Consciousness are specifications that no arm carries out yet.

name: The parts of the system
description: The record that names the second-level solutions of The Self: Integrity, Role Understanding, the Assembler and Model Plumbing. It carries no code of its own.
advantages: The second-level solutions are listed in one place and each keeps its own implementations.
disadvantages: A specification only: it adds no implementation of its own.

name: Composition of the form and internal context
description: The record that names the second-level solutions of Body: Internal Context, Learning, Nervous System, Hands and Acting.
advantages: A system adopts the parts it needs and declares the rest.
disadvantages: A specification only: each second-level solution has its own implementations, and this one adds none.

name: Composition of the processing of information
description: The record that names the second-level solutions of Intelligence: Mind, Higher Mind, Subconscious, Context Retriever and Critical Thinking.
advantages: Each way of processing information can be measured and replaced on its own.
disadvantages: A specification only: each second-level solution has its own implementations, and this one adds none.

name: Composition of the adaptation to humans
description: The record that names the second-level solution of Consciousness, Representatives, which builds on Asking Judgment and Feedback Learning.
advantages: Each person's way is learned apart from every other person's.
disadvantages: A specification only: no arm carries any of its solutions out yet.
